{{Quote|Two Mystics and a team of Voss Commandos are missing. They are in my charge.|[[Jiri-Su]]|<ref name="TOR:SoS2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Shrine of Silence|Voss}}</ref>}}
'''Rada-Ki''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] who lived during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. After the conquest, she contacted the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] to see about investigating the [[Shrine of Silence]], however when the Initiative took too long to get back to her, she and [[Tem-Su]] went ahead anyway. Whilst in the shrine, they were corrupted by [[The Curse]], an ancient [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] which inhabited the shrine, and together the pair were killed by the [[Alliance Commander]], who was investigating the ruins on behalf of Tem-Su's mother, [[Jiri-Su]]. After death, Rada-Ki's sprit aided the Commander in defeating The Curse by striking it with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="TOR:SoS"/>
